## Property Gallery (PG)

Hero image with a thumbnail filmstrip, selection state, photo counter, and an honest empty state. Render-only and storage-neutral: the consumer supplies resolved URLs (Property Listing feeds it `photos.resolvedUrls`).

### Example

Mounted in the linked 14 Birchwood Lane listing.

### Non-goals

No lightbox/zoom or touch-swipe in v1. No upload — the field owns acquisition, the gallery owns viewing.
